scope: PCB soldering and open-bench bring-up; closed-case harness and physical acceptance remain separate

steps.body_en: Keep the battery, domes and springs away from soldering. Use magnification, ESD tools, flux compatible with the cleaning process, controlled reflow/hot air, thermocouples, a DMM and a current-limited supply. U5/U6 have underside exposed pads; the E73 footprint also contains lands inside its body projection. An iron touching visible edges alone does not establish those joints. Follow the selected paste and component reflow limits; inspect hidden joints by an appropriate process. Do not solder or scrape the EC sensing electrodes. The map marks actual pad 1, not a photograph of the received package.
steps.body_zh: 电池、胶碗和弹簧远离焊接区。准备放大检查、ESD 工具、兼容清洗工艺的助焊剂、可控回流／热风、热电偶、万用表及限流电源。U5／U6 有底部散热焊盘，E73 封装也有位于模组本体投影内部的焊盘；仅用烙铁触碰可见边缘不能证明这些焊点已连接。按所选焊膏及元件回流限制操作，采用适当方法检查隐藏焊点。不要给静电容感应电极上锡或刮磨。图中标记的是实际焊盘 1，不是来料封装照片。

steps.body_en: Fit the listed power passives and U5/U6. Match every value and footprint to the table, including the 0805 effective-capacitance requirements. F1 is a fast 1 A Littelfuse fuse, not a resettable fuse; L1 is the specified 3020 inductor. Inspect IC pin 1 and exposed-pad paste coverage. Ordinary tented through-vias are retained; do not replace them with filled/capped fabrication. Leave U1 uninstalled until rail checks pass. No battery or power is connected during placement.
steps.body_zh: 按表焊接电源无源件及 U5／U6，逐项核对数值和封装，尤其是 0805 电容的有效容量要求。F1 是 Littelfuse 1 A 快断保险丝，不是自恢复保险丝；L1 使用指定的 3020 电感。检查芯片焊盘 1 和散热焊盘焊膏覆盖。保留普通盖油贯通孔，不改用填孔／铜盖帽工艺。电源检查通过前不安装 U1；放置及焊接时不接电池或任何电源。

steps.zh: 焊接电源门控及电池采样
steps.body_en: Install U7/U8, their pull-downs, QOD resistors and the battery divider/filter. R51/R52 are 1 MΩ, not 1 kΩ. With U1 absent, R49/R50 keep the battery-measurement and analog-front-end gates low. Do not bypass these gates or tie their enable pins high. Battery reporting is disabled in the delivered firmware pending measurement integration; fitting the hardware does not qualify a percentage reading.
steps.body_zh: 安装 U7／U8、下拉电阻、QOD 电阻及电池分压／滤波。R51／R52 是 1 MΩ，不是 1 kΩ。U1 尚未安装时，R49／R50 将电池测量和模拟前端门控保持为低。不要旁路门控或把使能脚直接接高。交付固件仍关闭电量上报，等待测量集成；焊好电路不代表电量百分比已验收。

steps.body_en: Fit the two 74HC4051 multiplexers, OPA350 and listed row/column/feedback parts. C10 is 220 pF; do not replace it with the stocked 100 nF capacitors. R17 is 1 kΩ and the reset pull-up R26 belongs to the next stage. Keep EC surfaces free of solder debris, fingerprints and cleaning residue. These circles are PCB sensing copper, not locations for MX sockets or per-key diodes.
steps.body_zh: 焊接两只 74HC4051、OPA350，以及表中的行列／反馈元件。C10 为 220 pF，不能用库存 100 nF 电容替代。R17 是 1 kΩ；复位上拉 R26 属于下一步。感应面不得残留焊渣、指印或清洗残留。这些圆形区域是 PCB 感应铜箔，不是 MX 热插拔座或逐键二极管焊接位。

steps.en: Fit reset and the status LED
steps.body_en: Fit SW1, R26, R32 and D2. D2 pad 1 is GND/cathode and pad 2 is LED_A/anode; verify the received LED's polarity mark. A dark LED alone is not a failed USB or BLE test. J3 is a six-pad pogo interface already on the PCB and needs no soldered header in this design. JP1 remains open; do not bridge it during assembly.
steps.body_zh: 安装 SW1、R26、R32、D2。D2 焊盘 1 为 GND／阴极，焊盘 2 为 LED_A／阳极；核对来料 LED 的极性标记。灯不亮本身不能判定 USB 或蓝牙失败。J3 是 PCB 上现成的六焊盘 pogo 接口，本设计不焊排针。JP1 保持断开，装配时不要短接。

steps.zh: 焊接模组附近去耦电容
steps.body_en: Fit back-side C31 (100 nF, 0402) and C32 (4.7 µF/16 V, 0603). C31 has moved to the lower corner beside the 3.3 V launch; do not fit it at the old upper-right location. These MLCCs are unpolarized, but their pad net assignments in the diagram are important for voltage tests. Keep their installed heights within the assembly limits.
steps.body_zh: 焊接背面的 C31（100 nF、0402）及 C32（4.7 µF／16 V、0603）。C31 已移到下角 3.3 V 引出附近，不要按旧版右上角位置安装。MLCC 无极性，但图中的焊盘网络用于后续测压，必须分清。安装后高度应满足装配限制。

steps.en: Fit the connectors and power switch
steps.body_en: Fit J1/J2/J4/J5 and SW100 after the smaller parts. All four headers are SH 1.0 mm; J2 is three-pin, not PH 2.0 mm. Inspect electrical pins and shell anchors. The existing C5 daughterboard is reused. USB harness: C5 pins 1/2/3/4 to J4 1/2/3/4. Power bridge: J5.1 to J1.1 and J5.2 to J1.4; J1.2/J1.3 stay empty. Check every conductor with power disconnected; never infer mating pin order from wire colors or a mirrored housing photo. Final closed-case cable lengths are not yet released. With all power disconnected, identify ON by continuity SW100.1–SW100.2 (VSYS to REG_EN), and OFF by SW100.2–SW100.3 (REG_EN to GND); do not guess from lever direction.
steps.body_zh: 小元件完成后安装 J1／J2／J4／J5 及 SW100。四个接口均为 SH 1.0 mm；J2 为三针，不是 PH 2.0 mm。检查信号脚及固定脚。已有 C5 子板直接沿用。USB 线束：C5 的 1／2／3／4 对应 J4 的 1／2／3／4。电源桥：J5.1→J1.1、J5.2→J1.4，J1.2／J1.3 留空。断电逐根测通断，不能按颜色或镜像插头照片猜针序。完整关壳线长尚未放行。 完全断电后，以 SW100.1～SW100.2 导通（VSYS 接 REG_EN）定义开机，以 SW100.2～SW100.3 导通（REG_EN 接地）定义关机，不按拨杆方向猜测。

steps.en: Check the rails before installing U1
steps.zh: 安装 U1 前先检查电源
steps.body_en: Use insulating supports on the open bench, with no battery and no host attached. Check for persistent shorts between USB_5V/GND, VSYS/GND and +3.3V/GND; charging capacitors can change resistance readings, so a beep alone is inconclusive. Feed the confirmed USB power path from a 5.0 V current-limited source; 50 mA is a project initial screening limit, not a specified keyboard operating current. Stop if limiting persists or any part heats. Check F1 input/output, then switch SW100 on and measure C45.1 to GND: expect about 3.3 V; 3.20–3.40 V is a project bench screening window with a suitable DMM, not full regulator qualification. U5 VSYS is a power-path output, not the 3.3 V rail. Disconnect power before rework. Do not inject 5 V at J3 or J2.
steps.body_zh: 裸板放在绝缘支撑上，不接电池和电脑。先检查 USB_5V／GND、VSYS／GND、+3.3V／GND 是否持续短路；电容充电会改变阻值，不能只按蜂鸣判定。用 5.0 V 限流电源接入已核对的 USB 电源路径；50 mA 是项目首次筛查限值，不是键盘工作电流规格。持续限流或元件发热时停止。检查 F1 两端，再打开 SW100，测 C45.1 对 GND，应接近 3.3 V；3.20～3.40 V 是使用合适万用表时的项目台架筛查窗，不代表稳压器完整验收。U5 的 VSYS 是电源路径输出，不是 3.3 V 电源。返修前断电，禁止向 J3 或 J2 注入 5 V。

steps.zh: 安装正面 E73 模组
steps.body_en: Disconnect all power, then install U1 on the front. Match pad 1 and antenna direction to the front-view drawing. Check the underside lands with an appropriate reflow/inspection method; do not assume edge wetting proves all 43 joints. Support and protect already fitted back-side parts and follow the module's thermal limits. Recheck shorts and the 3.3 V rail before programming. Preserve the four-layer antenna keepout. The retained steel plate still covers the provisional antenna band; this guide does not guarantee BLE range.
steps.body_zh: 完全断电后，将 U1 安装在正面，按正面图核对焊盘 1 与天线方向。采用适当回流及检查方法确认底部焊点，不能凭边缘润湿认定 43 个焊点都已连接。支撑、保护已经焊好的背面元件，并遵守模组热限制。刷写前重新查短路和 3.3 V。保留四层天线禁铜区；钢定位板仍覆盖暂定天线带，本教程不保证蓝牙距离。

steps.en: Program and test without a battery
steps.zh: 不接电池先刷写与测 USB
steps.body_en: Use the matching calibrator HEX through a 3.3 V logic SWD probe. J3: 1 VTref/+3.3V, 2 SWDIO, 3 GND, 4 SWDCLK, 5 RESET_N, 6 GND. VTref is a voltage reference, not permission to power the board from the probe. Use one confirmed power source and common ground. Initial HEX programs UICR NFC pins; BIN alone does not. No UF2 bootloader is provided. Disconnect the bench supply physically before connecting host USB; do not back-feed two 5 V sources. Connect the data-capable C5 USB cable and check host enumeration; no key events before valid calibration is expected. Use another keyboard to operate the calibration terminal. Keep a record of supply voltage/current, USB device detection and any fault logs.
steps.body_zh: 用 3.3 V 逻辑 SWD 探针写入匹配的校准版 HEX。J3：1 VTref／+3.3V、2 SWDIO、3 GND、4 SWDCLK、5 RESET_N、6 GND。VTref 是电压参考，不代表可由探针给整板供电。只使用一个已核实的供电源并共地。首次 HEX 包含 NFC 引脚 UICR 配置，单独 BIN 不包含；本设计没有 UF2 引导程序。接电脑 USB 前，物理断开台架电源，避免两个 5 V 电源互相反灌。接 C5 的可传数据 USB 线，检查电脑枚举；未获得有效校准前不发按键事件属于预期行为。使用另一把键盘操作校准终端，记录电压、电流、USB 设备识别及故障日志。

steps.body_en: Before connecting a real pack, obtain its signed electrical/thermal/dimensional specification and confirm J2 polarity: 1 PACK+, 2 PACK−, 3 the separate 10 kΩ NTC. Never short the NTC input as an operating substitute or solder directly to an unapproved cell. SW100 off does not isolate charging: R42/R43/R44 permit autonomous USB100 slow charging. Running firmware disables charging before host configuration and selects USB500 only after acceptance; system load shares that input budget. Perform the documented power-path, temperature, timer, termination and unplug/suspend tests with appropriate equipment. These physical tests are still open; this guide is not a passed safety test.
steps.body_zh: 连接真实电池前，取得签字确认的电气、温度及尺寸规格，核对 J2：1 PACK+、2 PACK−、3 独立 10 kΩ NTC。不能用短接 NTC 代替正常温度检测，也不能直接给未经批准的裸电芯焊接。SW100 关闭不等于充电隔离：R42／R43／R44 允许自主 USB100 慢充。固件运行时，主机配置前关闭充电，配置获准后才选择 USB500，系统负载与充电共享输入预算。使用适当仪器执行电源路径、温度、定时、终止及拔线／挂起测试；这些实物测试仍未完成，本教程不是安全测试通过记录。

steps.en: Fit the mechanism and calibrate all 60 keys
steps.zh: 装机构并校准全部 60 键
steps.body_en: Complete hot work and cleaning first. Follow the NiZ/steel-plate stabilizer guide: 60 housings/sliders, 60 domes and springs, three plate-mounted stabilizer pairs, and 28 insulated mounting sets; H26 receives no hardware. You can test the plate/PCB assembly without a shell, supported so components cannot touch the bench. Calibrate released and fully pressed samples for every active key using the matching calibrator, save, then program the matching normal HEX while preserving the final 64 KiB settings partition. Check USB typing, BLE pairing/reconnect, wake and key release on the bench. Final wire retention, closed-case assembly/explosion, thermal and RF acceptance remain open; do not force the case closed or compress the pack.
steps.body_zh: 先完成所有热作业及清洗，再按 NiZ／钢板卫星轴指南装 60 套轴座／滑块、60 个胶碗及弹簧、3 对钢板卫星轴和 28 套绝缘固定件，H26 不装任何固定件。可以不装外壳测试定位板／PCB 总成，但必须支撑到元件不碰台面。使用匹配校准版，采集每个有效键的释放与完全按下样本，保存后写入匹配正常版 HEX，并保留最后 64 KiB 设置分区。在台架上测试 USB 打字、蓝牙配对／重连、唤醒及释放。最终理线、关壳总装／爆炸图、温升和射频验收仍未完成，不要强行合壳或挤压电池。
